Kit summary

Quick SlashBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals 2 stages of 120% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, with a 50% chance to inflict a layer of [Bleed] on them for 2 turns. Each stage of attack deals extra 120% ATK DMG if this attack is enhanced. The extra DMG is considered Bleed DMG.
Glorious Rings Lv.1Increases the extra [Bleed] DMG dealt by each stage of attack of enhanced Quick Slash to 200%.
Swift AssaultActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 350% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] on them for 2 turns. Grants self [Stealth] for 2 turns if this skill is enhanced.
Glorious Rings Lv.2There is a same chance to inflict a layer of [Bleed] again for 2 turns when the enhanced Swift Assault successfully inflict [Bleed].
Crossed RingsPassive
Hertha activates up to 1 layer of [Left Ring] whenever she proactively casts a skill, enhancing her next basic attack; She activates 1 layer of [Right Ring] whenever she proactively performs a basic attack, enhancing her next skill. Hertha activates up to 1 layer [Double Rings] whenever she performs 2 enhanced basic attacks, which increases her SPD by 40% and [Bleed] DMG dealt by 40% for 4 turns. [Double Rings] will not be removed when the owner dies or at wave transition. Hertha activates 1 layer of [Right Ring] at the beginning of each wave.
Ring SlashesActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 2 stages of attack to a single enemy, each of which deals 140% ATK DMG and 260% ATK [Bleed] DMG, with a 60% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. Hertha gains an extra 20% SPD for 2 turns after the skill if this skill is enhanced.
Glorious Rings Lv.3The second stage of enhanced Ring Slashes will additionally trigger [Bleed] 1 time, up to 6 layers. Afterward, increases the SPD boost to 40% for 2 turns after the skill.
